purpose: Additional development robustness check; not holdout

underlying_B_generator.fit_pool: A_bg development partition, excluding all 1049 candidate persons
underlying_B_generator.prefecture: Independent draw conditional on generated sex, from fit pool
underlying_B_generator.time: Copula time quantile within generated onset/death state; non-event rows set to 10
underlying_B_generator.freshness: Reject QI collisions with every A_bg/B original and previously accepted fillers in this world
underlying_B_generator.rare_quota: Rejection sample exactly 24 minus shared rare per target, using the public detector

defense_generator: Original registered mixed style per target, applied after new underlying B is assembled
comparison: Fixed strength 1 versus strength 0, both with the same correct proxy-private mask
selection_action: None: preserve mia_selection.json and all existing v2 code/results
limitations: Fresh filler QI overlap is zero; original reused-filler worlds had at least about 673 common donors per pair. Neither matches the full real 25-27-person pairwise topology.
Only the 1049 candidate persons have exact real-style exclusive membership; the other original target overlaps are absent.
The background is B and person source is A_bg; actual contest roles are reversed.
Rare labels use the public detector surrogate, not true is_rare.
Development person partitions were used in prior work; new seeds are not new held-out people.
Synthetic population assumptions and separate defense assumptions both affect results.
